# pub title
title: "Brushstrokes of Autonomy: Exploring Artistic Expression for People with Motor Impairments through an AR-Guided Robotic Arm"

# publication image
image:
 name: brushstrokes_teaser_assets2026.jpg
 alt-text: "A participant with an upper-limb motor impairment uses an augmented reality (AR) head-mounted display (HMD) to draw on a virtual canvas, which is reproduced by the robotic arm on paper using acrylic markers, following the same strokes (left). The resulting pieces (right) reflect participants' personal artistic expression made physically present through the system." # provide a short description for the image #a11y

# short description of the publication
description: "We investigate how a hybrid augmented reality and robotic actuation system, controlled via head and voice interactions, supports creative drawing for people with upper-limb motor impairments. We show how live and deferred robotic execution fosters agency, authorship, and body extension, offering design considerations for creative assistive technologies."
